name: Dryer Vent John
description: Philadelphia's dryer vent cleaning specialist. Faster drying, lower bills, and one less fire risk in your house.

hero.headline: Dryer Vent John
hero.sub: Clogged vents make dryers slow, expensive, and dangerous. One visit fixes all three.

items: Residential dryer vent cleaning with before-and-after airflow readings
Bird guard and vent cap installation to keep nests out for good
Multi-unit and laundromat service with scheduled maintenance plans
Serving all of Philadelphia and the near suburbs
Same-week appointments, most jobs done in under an hour
Every job ends with a measured airflow before-and-after readout
Fully insured, flat pricing quoted before work starts

story.heading: About
paragraphs: John started cleaning dryer vents after a rowhome fire on his own block traced back to a clogged duct.
A decade later, the mission hasn't changed: every Philly dryer venting outside like it should.

items: Book online, get a two-hour window and a text when John's on the way.
No upsells. If the vent's clean, you'll hear that instead of a bill.
Photos and airflow numbers after every job, so you know what changed.

feature.heading: Faster drying from the very next load
feature.text: A clean vent cuts drying time, lowers the energy bill, and removes the top cause of dryer fires.

spotlight.heading: Multi-unit buildings, one crew
spotlight.text: Stacked laundry rooms and long duct runs are the jobs most handymen skip. This is the specialty.
